top_concerns: Limited novelty over CDM truncation-augmented cascades and Matryoshka/Relay diffusion; no empirical comparison to MDM
Efficiency baselines are weak: default EDM/LightningDiT step counts, no comparison to fast solvers or distillation, no test of combining with them
FID differences (about 0.01-0.1) are within noise; no seeds or variance; Te and sigma ranges tuned on test FID
Unfair or inconsistent comparisons: 75% training images, ImageNet speedup measured vs 100-NFE baseline while 50-NFE baseline is similar cost, unexplained IS jump
Small-scale evidence only (CIFAR/FFHQ-64/DiT-B 16x16 latent); memory claims and DiT variant unsupported or undescribed
